headline: Frontlines Shift as Six Sectors See Heavy Fighting
war_summary: Since the 21:17 edition the war’s most volatile theatres have evolved. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest front, logging 19 ownership changes in the last six hours and 55 in the past day, though both factions’ casualty rates have begun to cool from peaks above 1,100 per hour. Stlican Shelf has surged, adding five flips in the last two hours and 44 total today, with casualties accelerating sharply for both sides. Godcrofts erupted with four fresh captures in the past two hours and 24 total, warden losses climbing to six per hour while colonial losses stay low. Dead Lands continues to churn, recording 11 events in the last six hours and 13 daily, but its casualty curves are now cooling after earlier spikes near 1,000 per hour. Linn Mercy saw two new events in the last six hours and 20 overall, both sides’ losses rising modestly. Fisherman’s Row, quiet in the last two hours, still shows 15 flips over the past day across three bases. Other sectors such as Callahan’s Passage, Viper Pit and Stonecradle have gone quiet, with no recent two‑hour activity.
